source_behavior: An authenticated user opens the Approval Queue screen at /approvals to review real governed approval state before execution.

laravel_adaptation.frontend_dispatch: resources/js/app.tsx RouteElement dispatches route.key=approvals to ApprovalQueueRoute

authorization_and_tenant_isolation.guest: JSON route access returns 401 before tenant runtime access
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.missing_approvals_view: canonical route and backing API return 403
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.foreign_tenant: Tenant A direct access to Tenant B route/API returns 404 through tenant.context
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.tenant_scoping: TenantContext and tenant global scopes constrain persisted approval dependencies
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.idor: foreign tenant slug cannot select or read another tenant's queue

read_semantics.authoritative_reread: focused acceptance follows the canonical route and verifies the real backing API returns the exact persisted Approval row
read_semantics.empty_state: a tenant with no approval rows returns total=0 and data=[]

dependencies.notes: Reuses the existing real Approval Queue API, React runtime, tenant context, authorization, and persistence. No parallel approval architecture was created.
